message: This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
text:
Notes Improver is now scheduled for 12am every day (changes c9.0 to c9.5). The cost drops from about $125 a day to about **$0.03 a day**, one Haiku turn.

- **What it does at midnight:** it reads the last day's DONE tickets (`gate.landed`), reviewer rejections (`changes.requested`) and merge gate failures (`gate.rejected`). It works out why rejections and failures happened, and sends the Coordinator an idea only when a cause repeats or can be removed. It no longer wakes on any of those events.
- **Missed runs:** if the host is down at midnight, it runs once when it comes back.
- **Time zone:** I haven't set one because you haven't said which. Tell me your time zone so midnight means yours.
- **Not running yet:** it's still unconfirmed, and it won't start until you say "confirm Notes Improver".
- **Duplicate:** Notes Files Improver, the earlier draft, now does nearly the same job. Say the word and I'll discard it.

I didn't discard Notes Files Improver, so it's still there, unconfirmed, and costs nothing. Discarding is your call, so I'm waiting for you to say "discard Notes Files Improver".

quotes: make it a scheduled task for 12am every day
